name: phil/virtual-classroom-bundle
description: Live classes in Symfony on BigBlueButton or Jitsi: join links by role, attendance and recordings from signed webhooks, attendance counted as course completion.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the tables to the schema the ORM generates, for doctrine:migrations:diff
suggest.phil/courses-bundle: To offer a live class as an activity of a course, completed by the share of the session attended
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To give the attendance of a participant in the access and erasure requests
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:virtual-classroom:sync, which asks the servers who is in the open rooms and what they recorded
suggest.symfony/http-client: For the HTTP client the BigBlueButton servers are called with, the http_client service of FrameworkBundle
suggest.symfony/messenger: To sync a room from a message, SyncRoom, which carries its identifier only
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the participant from the authenticated user and give the moderator role by a Symfony role
